docs(spec): save offers every layer of the session's chain (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.nyy) (#742)

* docs(spec): save offers every layer of the session's chain, user, project and an excluded local file among them, each named by its role (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.nyy)

* docs(spec): the chain is user, project and local, or --config alone, with no cwd layer (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.nyy)

feat(renderer): a copy click's clipboard write is a copy effect the host performs, inside the click's turn (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.zty)

The click's order (its session's place, the daemon-wide journal turn, the
close that cuts it off) is taken inside its turn while the other verbs act in
place, so the turn waits out its own copy rather than returning it: a batch's
steps stay in order, a failed copy is still the click's reply, and the
launch-outcome rule stays the verb's one rule.
